prompt_used: You are given an image. Write a detailed natural language prompt that could have been used to generate this image. Focus on the most salient and unique visual elements such as the subjects, their clothing, expressions, actions, background, and composition. Describe the color palette, lighting, and overall style, including any cinematic or artistic qualities like camera angle, depth of field, or motion. Make the description as accurate and faithful to the image as possible. If small details are uncertain or ambiguous, omit them and prioritize capturing the overall scene, mood, and visual impression. The final prompt should be coherent, evocative, written as if by an expert visual artist or filmmaker recreating the exact scene.
caption: A vibrant, high-energy scene featuring seven young women dancing joyfully in a minimalist, seamless white studio. The group is mid-choreography, each striking a dynamic pose with arms raised and expressive, smiling faces, exuding a sense of celebration and unity. They wear coordinated outfits: white graphic t-shirts with bold black text, paired with black shorts and black-and-white sneakers, some accessorized with knee-high socks or subtle jewelry. Multicolored confetti rains down around them, creating a festive, playful atmosphere and adding movement and texture to the otherwise clean, uncluttered background. The lighting is bright and even, eliminating shadows and emphasizing the crispness of the scene. The camera angle is slightly elevated and wide, capturing the full group in motion and the expansive shower of confetti. The overall style is modern and energetic, reminiscent of a pop music video or a fashion editorial, with a focus on youthful exuberance, group synchronization, and a celebratory mood.
